cases_side_needs_area.name: cases_side_needs_area
cases_side_needs_area.value: "cases"."side" is null or "cases"."body_area" is not null

routine_item_sets_reps_range_order.name: routine_item_sets_reps_range_order
routine_item_sets_reps_range_order.value: "routine_item_sets"."reps_max" is null or ("routine_item_sets"."reps" is not null and "routine_item_sets"."reps_max" > "routine_item_sets"."reps")

routines_case_needs_customer.name: routines_case_needs_customer
routines_case_needs_customer.value: "routines"."case_id" is null or "routines"."customer_id" is not null

share_links_target_ids.name: share_links_target_ids
share_links_target_ids.value:
("share_links"."target" = 'customer' and "share_links"."routine_id" is null and "share_links"."weekly_plan_id" is null)
        or ("share_links"."target" = 'routine' and "share_links"."routine_id" is not null and "share_links"."weekly_plan_id" is null)
        or ("share_links"."target" = 'weekly_plan' and "share_links"."routine_id" is null and "share_links"."weekly_plan_id" is not null)
